units: mm, degrees; Blender/GLB converted to metres

sources.MM: AE300 Manual.pdf | E4.08.04 Rev13 package, individual pages carry their own revisions

height.source: IM Fig4.4.1, PDF22; visually checked; supersedes erroneous 741 transcription

mounts.source: IM Table6.1, PDF32; rear-left Z=-298 visually checked

eecu_box.source: IM Fig14.7 PDF81 enlarged visual recheck: overall raised height 58.5, width 247, plan depth 226. Corrects R3 transcription of 246 and main-body height as total.

eecu_connector_height.source: IM Fig14.7 PDF81 front view; centre relative to mounting plane

block_material.source: MM printed01-12 PDF34; supersedes earlier aluminium model

cam_architecture.value: DOHC; each cam operates one intake and one exhaust valve per cylinder; one chain-driven, one directly gear-driven

rod_length.reason: OEM rod length undisclosed. Adjustable reconstruction; not a measured AE300 dimension.

bank_angle.reason: Inclination reconstructed from IM front view; exact angle undisclosed

cylinder_x0.reason: Longitudinal bank placement reconstructed from side view

crank_z.reason: Controlled gear-centre layout; not OEM centre-distance data

piston_diameter.reason: 0.2 mm diametral demonstration clearance, not an OEM tolerance

deck_gap.reason: Demonstration TDC gap; bowl depth derived to match equivalent CR

gear_teeth.reason: Illustrative involute spur gears giving exact 1.69 ratio; OEM helical teeth/module undisclosed

gear_module.reason: Reconstruction choice for 202.95 mm shaft offset

valve_lift.reason: Idealized cam demonstration; OEM lift/duration/overlap unknown

valve_head_radius.reason: Generic size for four-valve packing; not OEM valve diameter

shell_wall.reason: Reconstruction wall thickness, not structural design

sensor_envelopes.value: generic connector, boss and probe solids
sensor_envelopes.reason: Exact supplier drawings and threads not supplied

notes: Datum is the centre of the front propeller flange; +X aft, Y as mounting table, +Z up.
Actual assembly bounding box is reported separately. Drawing envelope dimensions are reference constraints, not claimed surface fidelity.
CAD function means constrained mechanism demonstration, independent solids and sensor binding. No validated combustion, stress, fatigue, CFD or OEM control calibration.
All unlisted shape dimensions in the generator are controlled reconstruction choices. Source dimensions are never inferred from placeholders.
Aircraft-supplied EECU placement, intercooler, radiator, power lever and SIH additions are shown in a separate integration collection.
No engine-derived life prediction is implied by this geometry.
